purpose: ApplicationRunner that bootstraps website section/home-item rows in every environment and loads media records plus the complete JSON catalog/demo dataset only in local and DEV.
businessRules: Runs in every profile after Flyway; website sections and home items are always upserted, but reference media (the three logo records) is seeded only for local and dev profiles.
Full category, reference/product media, storefront item, store, product, and test-account seeding runs only for local and dev profiles.
UAT and PROD receive no media records, products, product assets, stores, or test accounts by default.
Runs after Flyway migrations (Order.MAX_VALUE) so all tables exist before seeding.
Every upsert uses ON CONFLICT DO UPDATE making seeding fully idempotent; safe to run on every restart.

Seed order matches FK dependency: families → product-types → attributes → filters → tax → styling → media assets → media variants → storefront sections → storefront items → store sections → store locations → products → dev auth accounts.
image_path field in JSON is metadata only (human reference to shresta-media paths); it is not inserted into the database.
JSON files are read from classpath:db/seed/<path>.json via ClassPathResource and parsed with Jackson ObjectMapper.
jsonb() helper serializes nested objects/arrays to a JSON string for ::jsonb cast columns.
seedDevAuthAccounts() issues CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS uat_seed_accounts before upserting, making it safe even if V1 was applied before the table was added to the migration plan.
seedDevAuthAccounts() runs only in local/dev and seeds all three auth tables in order: customer_accounts → customer_auth_identities → uat_seed_accounts.
The otp_code field in auth/dev-accounts.json drives the local/dev static OTP; UAT test rows must be provisioned explicitly if that capability is needed.
